name: GetLoginToken

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the list of regions supported by Alibaba Cloud Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID generated by the client
parameters.help_zh: 客户端生成的唯一ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The office network ID. This parameter has the same meaning as `OfficeSiteId`. Stop using `DirectoryId` and use `OfficeSiteId` instead. You can specify only one of `DirectoryId` and `OfficeSiteId`. Do not specify both
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID，与`OfficeSiteId`含义相同。建议停止使用`DirectoryId`，改为使用`OfficeSiteId`。`DirectoryId`和`OfficeSiteId`只能填写一个，不可同时填写
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The office network ID
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
The session ID for logon.

If no virtual MFA device is bound or client secondary authentication is not enabled, you do not need to specify `SessionId`.
If a virtual MFA device is bound or client secondary authentication is enabled, you must specify `SessionId` in the authentication stages after `ADPassword`. You can obtain `SessionId` from the response of the convenience account verification request (that is, when `GetLoginToken` is in the `ADPassword` stage)
parameters.help_zh:
登录的会话ID。

若未绑定虚拟MFA设备或者未开启客户端二次认证，则不需要填写`SessionId`。
若已绑定虚拟MFA设备或者已开启客户端二次认证，则`ADPassword`之后的登录认证阶段需要填写`SessionId`。可从便捷账号验证（即`GetLoginToken`请求处于`ADPassword`阶段）的返回结果中获取`SessionId`
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en:
The current logon authentication stage. The stages are as follows:

`ADPassword`: Verifies user credentials. Specify this value when using password-based authentication for a convenience account or an AD account.
`MFABind`: Binds a virtual MFA device.
`MFAVerify`: Verifies the security code generated by the virtual MFA device.
`TokenVerify`: Performs client secondary authentication.
`ChangePassword`: Changes the user password.
`KeepAliveVerify`: When the KeepAliveToken is valid, exchanges it for a LoginToken
parameters.help_zh:
当前登录认证阶段，依次为：

`ADPassword`：验证用户信息。当使用便捷账号或者AD账号的账密认证时填写此值。
`MFABind`：绑定虚拟MFA设备。
`MFAVerify`：验证虚拟MFA设备生成的安全码。
`TokenVerify`：客户端二次认证。
`ChangePassword`：修改用户密码。
`KeepAliveVerify`:  KeepAliveToken有效时，可用于换取LoginToken
parameters.name: current_stage

parameters.help_en: The username of the convenience user or AD user. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ADPassword`
parameters.help_zh: 便捷用户或AD用户的用户名。当`CurrentStage`为`ADPassword`时必填
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The password of the convenience user or AD user. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ADPassword`
parameters.help_zh: 便捷用户或AD用户的密码。当`CurrentStage`为`ADPassword`时必填
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The old password. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ChangePassword`
parameters.help_zh: 旧密码。当`CurrentStage`为`ChangePassword`时必填
parameters.name: old_password

parameters.help_en: The new password. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `ChangePassword`
parameters.help_zh: 新密码。当`CurrentStage`为`ChangePassword`时必填
parameters.name: new_password

parameters.help_en: The security code generated by the virtual MFA device. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `MFAVerify`
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟MFA设备生成的安全码。当`CurrentStage`为`MFAVerify`时必填
parameters.name: authentication_code

parameters.help_en: The operating system of the device running the client
parameters.help_zh: 运行客户端的设备的操作系统
parameters.name: client_os

parameters.help_en: The client version. If you are using the Alibaba Cloud Workspace client, you can view this parameter in the About dialog box on the client logon page
parameters.help_zh: 客户端版本。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的关于对话框中查看该参数
parameters.name: client_version

parameters.help_en: The secondary authentication verification code. If client secondary authentication is enabled in the Alibaba Cloud Workspace console and the current logon user is identified as a risk, this code is sent to the end user's mailbox. This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `TokenVerify`
parameters.help_zh: 若已在无影云电脑控制台开启客户端二次认证，且识别到当前登录用户有风险时，会发送该二次认证验证码到终端用户邮箱。当`CurrentStage`为`TokenVerify`时必填
parameters.name: token_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to keep the user logged on. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh: 是否保持登录
parameters.name: keep_alive

parameters.help_en: The token used to keep the user logged on. After a successful logon with the keep-logged-on option enabled, the operation returns a `KeepAliveToken`. While the `KeepAliveToken` is valid, you can call `GetLoginToken` with `CurrentStage` set to `KeepAliveVerify` to exchange it for a logon credential (LoginToken). This parameter is required when `CurrentStage` is set to `KeepAliveVerify`
parameters.help_zh: 用于保持登录的凭证（Token），在登录成功且用户开启了保持登录选项后，接口会返回`KeepAliveToken`，在`KeepAliveToken`有效期内可以调用`GetLoginToken`接口并将`CurrentStage`设为`KeepAliveVerify`来换取登录凭证（LoginToken）。当`CurrentStage`为`KeepAliveVerify`时，`KeepAliveToken`必填
parameters.name: keep_alive_token

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the client. If you are using the Alibaba Cloud Workspace client, you can view this parameter in the About dialog box on the client logon page
parameters.help_zh: 客户端唯一标识。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的关于对话框中查看该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_zh: 无影软件客户端类型

parameters.help_en: The features supported by the client
parameters.help_zh: 客户端支持的特性
parameters.name: available_features

parameters.help_en: The client name
parameters.help_zh: 客户端名称

Email.description_en:
The user's email address. Returned with the LoginToken after logon.    

For a convenience user, the email address set when the convenience user was created is returned.
For an AD user, the value is returned in the following format: `username@AD domain name`
Email.description_zh:
用户邮箱。在登录后随LoginToken返回。    

如果是便捷用户，返回创建便捷用户时设置的邮箱。
如果是AD用户，返回以下形式：`用户名@AD域名`

EndUserId.description_en: The convenience account username or AD username
EndUserId.description_zh: 便捷账号用户名或AD用户名

Industry.description_en: This is an internal field and is not available for external use
Industry.description_zh: 内部专用字段，不对外开放使用

KeepAliveToken.description_en: The token used to keep the user logged on. After a successful logon with the keep-logged-on option enabled, the operation returns a `KeepAliveToken`. If the keep-logged-on option is not enabled, an empty value is returned
KeepAliveToken.description_zh: 用于保持登录的凭证（Token），在登录成功且用户开启了保持登录选项后，接口会返回`KeepAliveToken`。若未开启保持登录选项，则返回空值

Label.description_en: The convenience user attributes. Returns an empty value for AD users
Label.description_zh: 便捷用户属性。如果是AD用户，则返回空值

NextStage.description_en:
The expected next stage. For example, if the administrator has enabled MFA authentication in the Alibaba Cloud Workspace console, after the username and password authentication passes (that is, after the `ADPassword` stage), this parameter returns `MFAVerify`, indicating that MFA authentication is required.

For details about each authentication stage, see the metric description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter for this operation
NextStage.description_zh:
预期的下一阶段。例如，若管理员在无影云电脑控制台开启了MFA认证，则当用户名密码认证通过后（即`ADPassword`阶段后），该参数会返回`MFAVerify`，表示此时需要做MFA认证。

关于各认证阶段的详细信息，参见本接口请求参数`CurrentStage`的参数说明
